summary: Retired US Army officer Dave Grossman, self-styled founder of killology, has trained thousands of American police to see every encounter as deadly and to kill reflexively, a mindset linked to police killings such as Philando Castile's.

evidence.note: Castile's killer attended a Bulletproof Mindset course in 2014; Grossman called most influential trainer
course bio: retired Army officer, former West Point psychology professor, author of popular books
course pages blame violent video games and TV for aggression; host weighs the weak evidence
Grossman forecasts massacres of schoolchildren to frighten trainees
long segment on the 1998 Dinkheller traffic-stop video used in police training
WWII and Vietnam firing-rate studies and conditioning soldiers to kill underpin his teaching
calls BLM protests treason, denies racial bias in policing, blames media
Minneapolis police killings frame the episode; many local officers took his course
post-2016 backlash after Castile killing, cancelled trainings, his views as of 2020

notes: Format borderline: much of the episode walks through a leaked copy of his course book page by page, which could argue for media-reading; chose deep-dive since the story profiles the man from many sources. covered_span starts at his 1956 birth only to meet the lifetime rule; his early life is not discussed. main_span start 1995 (On Killing) from general knowledge.
